item.title: Islami Andolan leader killed as truck runs him over in Kushtia
item.description: A leader of Islami Andolan Bangladesh (IAB) was killed and one of his associates injured when a mini-truck ran over them in Kushtia's Kumarkhali upazila on Friday night.The accident occurred around 10PM at Fultola area of the Kushtia-Rajbari regional highway.Deceased Abdur Razzak Badsha, 48, was the owner of Al-Madina Sweet Store near Kumarkhali bus stand and served as the president of IAB's Jagannathpur Union unit.Injured Mufti Khairul Bashar is one of his associate.According to police, witness

item.title: Play suspended at Australian Open over extreme heat
item.description: Australian Open organisers suspended play Saturday in Melbourne because of extreme heat forecast to hit 40C, before some matches resumed under roofs. Among the matches held up was the third-round clash between defending champion Jannik Sinner and the American Eliot Spizzirri at Rod Laver Arena. It resumed after about 10 minutes following the closure of the roof. "Play is suspended for all matches and practice on outside courts," the tournament said on X. item.title: Nasiruddin Patwary falls ill, postpones day's activities
item.description: Jatiya Nagorik Committee chief coordinator Nasiruddin Patwary postponed his Saturday's all activities as he suddenly fell ill.He continued his campaign from Fazr prayer to 8AM. Later, he felt physically ill, his media team member Shamil Abdullah confirmed this to media around 9:15AM.
